# Desire

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Desire>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An intentional mode of wanting without commitment — the agent would welcome the goal's satisfaction but has not committed to pursuing it (UFO-C: desire). Inheres in exactly one agent ([`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md)). Promote a [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md) to an [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) by minting the [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) and suppressing the [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)'s tenure — never by mutation ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the lowest commitment grade — the agent wants the goal satisfied but has not settled on pursuing it; the wanting that has not yet become an [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid once the agent has committed internally (use [`gmeow:Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md)) or toward another agent (use [`gmeow:Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md)); do not mutate a [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md) into an [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) — mint the [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) and suppress the [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)'s tenure ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Mint a [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md), set [`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md) (one agent) and [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](../properties/gmeow-intentionGoal.md) (one [`Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md)); promote by minting the higher-grade moment and closing the [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)'s [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) rather than deleting it.

### Examples

- ex:wishForRain a [`gmeow:Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md); [`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md) ex:lillith; [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](../properties/gmeow-intentionGoal.md) ex:droughtEnds.
